caption: The video captures a close view of a small stream cascade in a wooded setting. Water pours continuously over a central rounded boulder and the rocks above it, forming a thin glassy sheet on the boulder's upper face and a frothy white waterfall down its front and left side. This cascade churns into a turbulent pool at the lower left, while a calmer, dark reflective pool sits at the lower right. Moss-covered rocks frame the scene, and green leafy plants with scattered pine needles and fallen leaves line the right bank. The white foam and bubble patterns on the falling water shift shape and position over time, indicating turbulent flow. Moving ripples and highlights travel down the thin sheet draping the boulder's left side, and the inflow stream at the top center shows varying white streaks and splashes. The overall structure of the cascade persists unchanged throughout.
